title: manihot gracilis var. tenuifolia
intro: Manihot gracilis var. tenuifolia, commonly known as the wild cassava or narrow-leaved manihot, is a species of shrub native to tropical regions. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Manihot gracilis var. tenuifolia include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-spasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, diarrhea, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
